correctness.rationale: Exact Brownian-bridge kernel integrals, two-observation Gaussian Schur-complement inversion, differentiation to the displayed sextic, and a Descartes one-sign-change proof establish one and only one positive root for every eta>0. Direct noncollocation comparison maximizes repeated-site gain over every location. Local symbolic script verifies identities and 70 rational instances; the universal result is analytic.

value.rationale: Symmetric paired sampling is an intrinsic symmetry-constrained two-measurement design for the endpoint-pinned Brownian Green kernel. The theorem classifies every finite noise value with a unique computable separation and asymptotic scale, and strictly beats every repeated-site design, not just an arbitrary numerical case. The target is integrated path error, naturally distinct from scalar quadrature. No broader or practical speedup claims.
